packages.name: bignum
packages.reason: The package had the ability to download files from an Amazon AWS S3 bucket when installing it, which included malicious files designed for critical users.

analysis: The text describes a security issue involving the npm package 'bignum', which was used to download malicious files from an Amazon S3 bucket. This package was exploited by threat actors to distribute malware by replacing legitimate files with malicious ones in abandoned S3 buckets. The text highlights the risk of using open-source software packages that rely on potentially compromised S3 buckets for distributing binary files.
